# Six sentences share one four-word run; five share another, which is allowed.
# tags: band=builder reading=grade6+ kind=sentences case=mixed
Mia rides the big red cart.
Ben fixed the big red cart today.
We love the big red cart!
Is that the big red cart?
Look at the big red cart go.
Rosa painted the big red cart blue.
The snow is soft and white.
Today the snow is soft.
Oh, the snow is soft!
Now the snow is soft again.
Here the snow is soft too.
